name: Lane Clash
hook: Play cards, send units, take their towers.
how: Elixir fills over time. Drag a card onto your side and its units march down a lane. Take more towers in two and a half minutes, or their king tower, to win.
controls: Drag a card onto the field, or tap a card then tap the field
uses: The host's browser runs every unit and tower; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot plays the other side when you're alone, and a friend who joins takes over from it.
Both players see the same fight, about 10 updates a second.
Most wins, shown after every match.
ideas: Add a spell card that hits an area
Let players build a deck before the match
